title: Checkout redirects to login for a logged-out user
reproduction_status: The reported invalid-checkout error was not reproduced
preconditions: A product is in the cart
steps: Add a product to the cart
reported_behavior: An invalid error appears when using the checkout option.
observed_behavior: The application redirects to /login?redirect=cart. No invalid-checkout error is displayed.
limitations: No authenticated test session was available. No order was submitted.
